item.title: 【UPSCALED】Papa Roach - Swerve (feat. Fever333 & Sueco) [4K AI Upscale | HEVC 10-bit | PCM 24-bit 48 kHz | DD+ Dolby Atmos]
item.description:
Genre: Hip Hop, Rock
Style: Rap-Metal, Funk, Pop-Punk
Year: 2021
Video Source: Apple Music
Audio Source: Qobuz and Apple Music

"Swerve" is a song by American rock band Papa Roach, released on August 1, 2021, featuring Jason Aalon Butler of FEVER 333 and rapper Sueco. The track is part of their eleventh studio album, Ego Trip, which was released on April 8, 2022, and marked their first independent release under their own label, New Noize Records. The song blends rap-metal with funk and pop-punk influences, representing a significant departure from the band’s earlier nu-metal sound.

A Rockzilla Remix of "Swerve" was later released on January 6, 2023, featuring Hollywood Undead members Charlie Scene and Funny Man. This remix was released to promote the second leg of the Rockzilla Tour, with Jacoby Shaddix, Charlie Scene, and Funny Man performing together live during the tour. The remix includes additional verses and references to Papa Roach songs like "Born for Greatness" and "Scars", with a notable line: "Fuck you, Tony!" referencing band member Tony Palermo.

The official music video for the original version of "Swerve" features Jason Aalon Butler and Sueco, and was praised for its energetic collaboration and creative direction. The song received attention for its bold sonic shift and high-profile guest appearances, reflecting Papa Roach’s ongoing evolution in sound and collaboration.
